description: Jada, a witch`s apprentice, finds herself in a peaceful village. A peaceful countryside, awash in small hardships and small joys, is suddenly invaded by a horde of monstrous goblins. "This can`t be happening...!" Jada, a witch but still an apprentice, loses the grimoire she was entrusted with and is instantly captured by the goblins. Her small body is trampled by the giant, mutant goblin, and with no way to escape, she can only cry out. She conceives, gives birth, but it doesn`t end there.

titles.title: 魔女見習い ジェイダ
